sub_answers.text: He was named to the All-ACC First Team in his sophomore season.[d30156859s2p0] He was ACC Defensive Player of the Year and ACC Player of the Year in his junior season.[d30156859s2p0] In his senior season he won numerous national player of the year awards, including unanimous selection for the Oscar Robertson Trophy and the Naismith Award, and was voted ACC Player of the Year again.[d30156859s2p0]

sub_answers.text: He was a leading post scorer and rebounder, producing games of 12 points and 22 rebounds and 14 points and 16 rebounds while also contributing assists [d30156859s2p0]. He was recognized for his defense, earning ACC Defensive Player of the Year honors [d30156859s2p0]. He demonstrated leadership, guiding Wake Forest to ACC tournament championships and deep NCAA tournament runs [d30156859s2p0].
